pages.title: Staff handbook
pages.body: Where to find policies, forms and who to ask.

pages.title: Expenses and mileage
pages.body: Mileage is 45p a mile for the first 10,000 miles. Claims go through the HR system by the 5th of the month.

pages.title: Lone working
pages.body: Anyone visiting a home alone logs in and out with the lone working app. Missed check-ins go to the duty manager.

pages.title: Phone system: transferring calls
pages.body: Press transfer, dial the extension, wait for an answer, then press transfer again. The contact centre hunt group is 2200.

pages.title: Booking meeting rooms
pages.body: Rooms 1 and 2 and the boardroom are booked through the shared calendar. The boardroom is kept free on board evenings.

pages.title: Data protection basics
pages.body: Never send tenant details to a personal email address. Report a data breach to the data protection officer within 24 hours.

pages.title: Working from home
pages.body: Office staff can work from home up to three days a week by agreement with their manager.

pages.title: Printing and post
pages.body: Letters to tenants are printed and posted by the post room at 3pm each day. Put urgent post in the red tray.
